snapshot.title: Wire PostHog web shell config to Vercel runtime env
snapshot.description: Replace hardcoded PostHog web shell values with runtime config loaded from Vercel env vars, while preserving safe fallbacks for local development.

acceptanceCriteria.text: react-shell reads PostHog config from runtime endpoint with fallback defaults
web/public/app.js reads PostHog config from runtime endpoint with fallback defaults
No personal API token is exposed to browser runtime config

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Add /api/runtime-config endpoint that exposes only safe public runtime config (PostHog project token/region/survey id + optional Supabase public keys), mapping current Vercel variable names.
2. Update react-shell.js to lazily load runtime config once and use it for PostHog/survey (with existing constants as fallback).
3. Update web/public/app.js with the same runtime config loading pattern for parity with local shell server usage.
4. Validate by static checks and summarize exact env names consumed; ensure personal token is not exposed.
snapshot.implementationNotes: Validation: node syntax check passed for web/public/app.js and api/runtime-config.js. react-shell.js contains browser ESM imports so Node script check is not directly applicable.
